name: voltfit
description: VoltFit — EV Bike Battery & Certified Installation Platform

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const mime = {'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.json':'application/json'}; http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = path.join(__dirname, 'web', req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); fs.readFile(p, (err, data) => { if (err) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } else { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': mime[path.extname(p)] || 'text/plain'}); res.end(data); } }); }).listen(3000, () => console.log('VoltFit running at http://localhost:3000'));"
